historical_record.description: The Richmond Center, on 18th Avenue between Lake and California Streets, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Board of Supervisors transferred the Richmond Playground land on 18th Avenue between Lake and California Streets to the Playground Commission.
